info.title: Pupgy API
info.description: Contract between the Pupgy API and its consumers (storefront, admin). Additive changes only within v1 — see docs/api/versioning.md.

waiting.description: Enqueued and not yet picked up

delayed.description: Scheduled for later, or waiting out a retry backoff

failed.description: Gave up after every attempt. Alert on this increasing.

oldestWaitingSeconds.description: Age of the oldest waiting job. Climbing means nothing is consuming.

status.description: `stalled` means work is queued and no worker is taking it

password.description: Minimum 10 characters. Length beats character-class rules.

audience.description: Which app this session is for (ADR-007)

accessToken.description: JWT. Keep in memory; never in localStorage.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires

audience.description: Which app the link should open — the password itself is shared (ADR-007)

token.description: The token from the emailed link

slug.description: Public URL segment: /shop/{slug}. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

email.description: Must already have a platform account

sellable.description: False for a combination that exists but is not offered

images.description: Ordered; the first is the cover

optionValues.description: One value per option, in option order. Empty for a product with no options.

code.description: Merchant's own code, unique per shop

sellable.description: False for a combination that exists in the grid but is not offered

stock.description: Absolute value. Phase 7 adds safe adjustments.

uploadUrl.description: PUT the file here directly, with the same Content-Type

key.description: Send this back when registering the image

maxBytes.description: Larger uploads are rejected on registration

key.description: The key returned by the upload-url endpoint

alt.description: Alt text. Worth filling in: it is read by screen readers and by search engines.

firstItem.description: For the thumbnail and "và N sản phẩm khác"

reference.description: What the buyer must put in the transfer memo

awaitingPayment.description: QR orders whose transfer has not arrived yet

completed.description: Accepted by the buyer — escrow released

unitPrice.description: Integer VND, read live — never what was shown when it was added
